tables.Purpose: Master list of product categories used to group SKUs for reporting and planning

columns.Description: Name of the product category (e.g. Beverages, Apparel)

BusinessRules: Always filter active categories -> IsActive = 1 AND IsDeleted = 0
This is a master table, do not use for demand or forecast calculations
Join with Product using CategoryId to get category name for a SKU

tables.Purpose: Master list of SKUs/products sold and forecasted across the business

columns.Description: Unit the product is sold/forecasted in (e.g. EA, CASE)

columns.Warning: Do not use for revenue reporting, use SalesHistory.Revenue instead

columns.Description: Date the product was first launched
Date the product master record was created

BusinessRules: Always filter active products -> IsActive = 1 AND IsDeleted = 0 unless the user explicitly asks for discontinued/inactive products
This is a master table, do not calculate demand, revenue, or forecast values from this table alone
Join with SalesHistory using ProductId for actual demand/revenue
Join with ForecastDetail using ProductId for forecasted demand
Join with Category using CategoryId to resolve category name
A product recently launched (LaunchDate within the last 90 days) has limited sales history; treat forecasts for it cautiously

tables.Purpose: Master list of distribution centers, stores, and regions demand is tracked and forecasted for

columns.Description: Type of location: DC (distribution center), Store, or Region
Sales/supply region the location belongs to

BusinessRules: Always filter active locations -> IsActive = 1 AND IsDeleted = 0
Use Region to aggregate demand/forecast/inventory across multiple locations
This is a master table, do not use for demand or forecast calculations directly

tables.Purpose: Master list of sales channels demand is tracked through

columns.Description: Name of the sales channel (Retail, Online, Wholesale)

BusinessRules: Always filter active channels -> IsActive = 1 AND IsDeleted = 0
Join with SalesHistory using ChannelId to break demand down by channel

tables.Purpose: System roles used for access control across the planning platform

columns.Description: Unique identifier for role. Admin = 1, Demand Planner = 2, Supply Planner = 3, Category Manager = 4, Analyst = 5, Executive = 6

BusinessRules: Always filter active roles -> IsActive = 1 AND IsDeleted = 0
This table describes internal access control; only Admin should query it directly

tables.Purpose: Platform users: demand planners, supply planners, category managers, analysts, and admins

columns.Description: Region the planner is primarily responsible for
Date the staff record was created

BusinessRules: Always filter active staff -> IsActive = 1 AND IsDeleted = 0
Join with UserRoles using RoleID to resolve role name
Only Admin role may query this table directly; other roles asking about staff/user data should be told they are not authorised

tables.Purpose: Actual historical demand (units sold and revenue) per product, location, and channel. The single source of truth for actual demand.

columns.Description: Unique identifier for the sales record
Date of the sale / actual demand observation
Price per unit at time of sale
Total revenue for this sale (QuantitySold * UnitPrice, already computed and stored)
Indicates the sale happened during an active promotion

BusinessRules: This table is the ONLY source of actual demand and actual revenue
Do NOT use ForecastDetail.ForecastedQuantity as actual demand
Total Demand = SUM(QuantitySold), Total Revenue = SUM(Revenue)
Use SaleDate for all time-based filtering (today/this week/this month/this year)
To break demand down by category, join Product then Category
To break demand down by region, join Location
IsPromotion = 1 rows should be included in totals unless the user explicitly asks for non-promotional/baseline demand

tables.Purpose: Promotional calendar for products, used to explain demand spikes and plan promotional uplift

columns.Description: Discount percentage applied during the promotion
Type of promotion (Discount, BOGO, Bundle, Clearance)

BusinessRules: A promotion is 'currently active' when today's date is between StartDate and EndDate inclusive AND IsActive = 1 AND IsDeleted = 0
Join with SalesHistory using ProductId and a date range overlap to analyse promotional uplift
Do not use this table for revenue or demand totals directly, use SalesHistory

tables.Purpose: Current on-hand and in-transit stock levels per product and location, used for stockout/overstock risk analysis

columns.Description: Unique identifier for the inventory record
Product this stock level is for
Location this stock level is at
Units currently on hand at this location
Units currently in transit to this location
Minimum stock level the location should maintain
Stock level at which a replenishment order should be triggered
When this stock snapshot was last refreshed

BusinessRules: Stockout risk / understocked = OnHandQuantity < SafetyStock
Needs reorder = (OnHandQuantity + InTransitQuantity) <= ReorderPoint
Overstocked = OnHandQuantity > ReorderPoint * 3
This table is a current snapshot, not a time series; do not sum OnHandQuantity across dates
Join with Product and Location to get names

tables.Purpose: Classifies each product's demand pattern (smooth, erratic, intermittent, lumpy, seasonal, trending, new launch) to guide which forecasting method is appropriate

columns.Description: Unique identifier for the classification record
Location the classification applies to (nullable = classified globally across all locations)
Demand pattern category: Smooth, Erratic, Intermittent, Lumpy, Seasonal, Trend, or New Launch
Average Demand Interval - average number of periods between non-zero demand observations
Squared coefficient of variation of demand size, used with ADI to derive PatternType (Syntetos-Boylan classification)

BusinessRules: PatternType is precomputed; do not attempt to recompute ADI/CV2 from SalesHistory unless explicitly asked to derive it
When LocationId IS NULL the classification applies to the product globally across all locations
Use the most recent ClassifiedDate per product when a product has been reclassified over time

tables.Purpose: Metadata for a single forecasting job/run: which model was used, when it ran, and its status

columns.Description: Unique identifier for the forecast run
Forecasting model/algorithm used (e.g. ARIMA, Prophet, ETS, LSTM, Moving Average)
Date/time the forecast run was executed
Number of days into the future this run forecasts
Run status: Completed, Failed, or Running
Staff member who triggered the run

BusinessRules: 'Latest forecast run' = the row with MAX(RunDate) WHERE Status = 'Completed'
Only Status = 'Completed' runs should be used for reporting forecasted numbers unless the user asks about run health/failures
Join with ForecastDetail using ForecastRunId to get per-product forecasted quantities
Join with ForecastAccuracy using ForecastRunId to get accuracy metrics for that run

tables.Purpose: Per-product, per-location forecasted demand for future periods, produced by a ForecastRun

columns.Description: Unique identifier for the forecast detail row
The run that produced this forecast
The future period this forecast is for

columns.Warning: This is a PREDICTION, never present it as actual demand

columns.Description: Lower bound of the forecast confidence interval
Upper bound of the forecast confidence interval
Confidence level of the interval, e.g. 0.95 for 95%

BusinessRules: Always scope ForecastDetail queries to a specific ForecastRunId (default to the latest completed run per RULE ForecastRun) unless the user names a different run
Never sum ForecastedQuantity across multiple different ForecastRunId values for the same product/period, this double counts
Do NOT use this table to answer questions about actual/historical demand, use SalesHistory instead

tables.Purpose: Precomputed comparison of forecasted vs actual demand once a forecasted period has occurred, including error metrics

columns.Description: Unique identifier for the accuracy record
The historical period this accuracy measurement covers
What was forecasted for this period
What actually happened (sourced from SalesHistory) for this period
Mean Absolute Percentage Error for this product/period, as a percentage (e.g. 12.5 = 12.5%)
columns.FormulaHint: Forecast Accuracy = AVG(MAPE), lower is better

columns.Description: Signed average error; positive = systematically over-forecasting, negative = systematically under-forecasting

BusinessRules: This table is precomputed; NEVER manually recompute MAPE by joining ForecastDetail and SalesHistory row by row, always read MAPE/AbsoluteError/Bias directly from this table
'Forecast accuracy' or 'MAPE' questions -> AVG(MAPE) grouped as requested (by product/category/region/run)
Lower MAPE = more accurate. 'Worst forecast accuracy' = highest MAPE. 'Best forecast accuracy' = lowest MAPE
'Over-forecasting' = positive Bias, 'under-forecasting' = negative Bias
Filter by ForecastRunId to compare accuracy across specific runs/models

tables.Purpose: Supply orders placed to replenish stock at a location based on demand forecasts and inventory position

columns.Description: Unique identifier for the replenishment order
Date the order is expected to arrive
Order status: Pending, Shipped, Delivered, or Cancelled
Staff member who placed the order

BusinessRules: 'Open orders' or 'pending orders' = Status IN ('Pending','Shipped')
'Overdue orders' = Status != 'Delivered' AND ExpectedDeliveryDate < today
Do not use this table for demand or forecast totals, only for supply/order status

Definition: Never use ForecastDetail.ForecastedQuantity for actual demand
GlobalBusinessRules.WhenToUse: When the user asks for actual/historical demand or units sold

Definition: Do not recompute Revenue from UnitPrice * QuantitySold, the column is already correct
GlobalBusinessRules.WhenToUse: When the user asks for revenue, sales value, or income

Definition: Calculate AVG(MAPE) for accuracy percentage, AVG(Bias) for over/under-forecasting tendency
Never derive accuracy by manually joining ForecastDetail with SalesHistory
GlobalBusinessRules.WhenToUse: When the user asks about forecast accuracy, MAPE, forecast error, or forecast bias

Definition: Use ForecastRun to find the row with MAX(RunDate) WHERE Status = 'Completed'
Join ForecastDetail on that ForecastRunId to get the current forecasted quantities
GlobalBusinessRules.WhenToUse: When the user asks for 'the forecast' without naming a specific run or model
When the user asks about stockout risk, understocked items, or reorder needs

MetricSafetyRules: NEVER present ForecastDetail.ForecastedQuantity as actual/historical demand
NEVER manually recompute MAPE, AbsoluteError, or Bias when ForecastAccuracy already has them
NEVER sum ForecastedQuantity across multiple ForecastRunId values for the same product/period
Always scope forecast questions to the latest completed ForecastRun unless another run is specified
Do not double count revenue or demand across channels unless the user asks for a channel breakdown or total across channels
